overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on evaluating LLM performance on medical MCQs rather than NLG quality. The NLG aspects (textbook and question generation) serve as means to create the evaluation benchmark. Human evaluation was conducted by physicians for benchmark quality assessment, not for evaluating NLG outputs per se. Automatic metrics were used for model performance evaluation on the MCQ task.
